lines.1: 「And that's where your beautiful-girl ratings boost comes in.」
lines.2: 「Hold on. I locked the front door.」
lines.3: 「...You came in through the second-floor window, didn't you?」
lines.4: Crab popped up out of nowhere and stole a bite from my plate.
lines.5: 「Mmm. Now that's soaked up the flavor. You'll make somebody a fine wife.」
lines.7: 「Seriously, break the habit of stealing other people's food. You're supposed to be a lady. Have some manners.」
lines.8: 「Oh, let me have this much. You're kind of stingy, Leo.」
lines.10: 「So fussy. Fine, lend me your chopsticks.」
lines.11: She snatched the chopsticks right out of my hand and started drinking my miso soup.
lines.12: 「Ahh, that was good. I'll be upstairs.」
lines.13: It felt like dealing with a badly trained puppy.
lines.16: 「Maybe. But I like to think I spoil you and Fukahire too.」
lines.17: 「Then cut back on the green and yellow vegetables.」
lines.18: 「The ribs are great, but this mountain of vegetables looks like horse feed.」
lines.19: 「Idiot. I'm making sure your diet is balanced. All you normally eat is carbs. Now stop complaining and eat up.」
lines.21: Though it was thanks to him that I wasn't malnourished.
lines.22: I shoveled down the rest of my meal in one go.
